name: spruce budworm outbreaks

slots.Xi: budworm density u in units of the density at which predation saturates: concentrations in R_+^1
slots.C: logistic growth with predation by birds that saturates; the forest changes slowly and enters as the fixed capacity k; fluctuations of the population enter as noise
slots.P: bounded write toward a target, release, measurement; sweep of k
slots.A: r=0.55, k=8; control k in (3.0, 20.0); noise D=0.01

provenance: D. Ludwig, D. D. Jones and C. S. Holling, J. Anim. Ecol. 47, 315 (1978)

events.kind: saddle-node (fold): a state appears or vanishes; written by a pulse past the threshold

required: A quadratic term makes the write one-sided (a threshold): the material must supply the mirror term -a2 s^2, from a symmetric partner of the critical mode or a second parameter tuned to the cusp.
Changing the control also pushes the critical mode, so a sweep writes a fixed state: the protocol must add the opposite field, or the material must be symmetric under reversal of the mode.
